y=xk+1∉{x1,…,xk},z∉{x1,…,xk,y},1(z−xj)(z−y)=1xj−y(1z−xj−1z−y),1∏i=1k+1(z−xi)=1z−y∑j=1kwjz−xj=∑j=1kwj(xj−y)(z−xj)+1z−y∑j=1kwjy−xj=∑j=1k1(z−xj)∏1≤i≤k+1i≠j(xj−xi)+1(z−y)∏i=1k(y−xi)=∑j=1k+11(z−xj)∏1≤i≤k+1i≠j(xj−xi).\begin{aligned} y&=x_{k+1}\notin\{x_1,\ldots,x_k\},\qquad z\notin\{x_1,\ldots,x_k,y\},\\ \frac1{(z-x_j)(z-y)} &=\frac1{x_j-y}\left(\frac1{z-x_j}-\frac1{z-y}\right),\\ \frac1{\prod_{i=1}^{k+1}(z-x_i)} &=\frac1{z-y}\sum_{j=1}^{k}\frac{w_j}{z-x_j}\\ &=\sum_{j=1}^{k}\frac{w_j}{(x_j-y)(z-x_j)} +\frac1{z-y}\sum_{j=1}^{k}\frac{w_j}{y-x_j}\\ &=\sum_{j=1}^{k}\frac1{(z-x_j)\prod_{\substack{1\le i\le k+1\\i\ne j}}(x_j-x_i)} +\frac1{(z-y)\prod_{i=1}^{k}(y-x_i)}\\ &=\sum_{j=1}^{k+1}\frac1{(z-x_j)\prod_{\substack{1\le i\le k+1\\i\ne j}}(x_j-x_i)}. \end{aligned}y(z−xj​)(z−y)1​∏i=1k+1​(z−xi​)1​​=xk+1​∈/{x1​,…,xk​},z∈/{x1​,…,xk​,y},=xj​−y1​(z−xj​1​−z−y1​),=z−y1​j=1∑k​z−xj​wj​​=j=1∑k​(xj​−y)(z−xj​)wj​​+z−y1​j=1∑k​y−xj​wj​​=j=1∑k​(z−xj​)∏1≤i≤k+1i=j​​(xj​−xi​)1​+(z−y)∏i=1k​(y−xi​)1​=j=1∑k+1​(z−xj​)∏1≤i≤k+1i=j​​(xj​−xi​)1​.​
